inventory.notes: Initial bounded Python feature row. This is not an inventory of all Python capabilities or a claim of native pcc1 qualification.

features.title: Unicode identifier classification and NFKC normalization
features.scope: Implementation includes owned Unicode 17 XID and NFKC data, UTF-8 source offsets, raw soft-keyword spelling, and compiler-owned symbol encoding. Host unit/object checks and pcc0/self native name and owned-lexer programs match CPython across GC0-4. Six affected Lib/test modules pass the old lexical boundary but still yield 0/1389 native successes. Missing means final qualification and normalized immutable evidence rows are incomplete; native pcc1 and whole-Python gates remain pending. No complete Python language claim is made.

features.title: Generic function and class annotation scopes
features.scope: Raw syntax preserves names, parameter kinds, bounds and defaults. Runtime annotation scopes and lazy alias evaluation are not implemented; lowering rejects these declarations explicitly rather than erasing them. Parser-only progress does not claim runtime support.
